annotations.title: Search the words of the Bible

description: Find every verse in the stored King James Version (31102 verses) containing all the given words, or an exact phrase in double quotes, in canonical order and paged, optionally within one book or testament. A literal text match, not a search by meaning: KJV wording applies, so modern words may be missing (try "charity" as well as "love"). Use for "where does the Bible say 'be still'" or "verses with mercy in Psalms". For verses on a feeling use verses_for; for a topic explained use what_the_bible_says_about; for a known reference use scripture_passage. Up to 6 words of 2+ letters are used. No match returns count 0; total_matches may be capped (capped true). Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

book.description: Optional single book, full name or common abbreviation: "Psalms", "John", "1 Cor".

cursor.description: Opaque paging token: the next_cursor value from the previous answer of this same call. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Words that must all appear ("mercy truth"), or an exact phrase in double quotes ("\"be still\""). Case-insensitive.

testament.description: Optional: "old" or "new" to search one testament.

whole_words.description: true (default): whole words only, so "love" does not match "loved". false: match inside words.

name: scripture_search

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

capped.description: True when matching stopped at the internal ceiling, so total_matches is a lower bound.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page; null when there is none.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

results.description: Matching verses in canonical order: reference, verbatim KJV text, web link.

scope.description: What was searched: the whole Bible, a testament, or a book.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Search the words of the Bible
